d: This time on "Guest in the Newsroom," two-time Olympic medalist Neeraj Chopra joined us. He spoke candidly about his friendship with Pakistani javelin athlete Arshad Nadeem, the 90-meter debate, marriage, and his career. Neeraj revealed why he hasn't been able to achieve a 90-meter throw yet, citing injuries that have hindered his practice. He also discussed his new coach, the differences between foreign and Indian athletes, and shared insights on how Haryana has become proactive in promoting sports. Neeraj elaborated on what it would take to make India a global superpower in sports.
